entries.german: Philipp von Bibern, Amtmann zu Creglingen, Bericht an Markgraf Casimir den Aufenthalt der Hausfrau Zeyholfs von Rosenberg daselbst, d.d. Sonntag Judic. 2. April
entries.english: Philipp von Bibern, Amtmann zu Creglingen, reports to Margrave Casimir about the stay of Zeyhold's wife at Rosenberg there, dated Sunday Judicive, April 2

facts.content: had his wife staying at Creglingen, as reported by Philipp von Bibern, Amtmann zu Creglingen.
